meta.scope: Restrict S099 source card to USPTO primary claim 1 and remove unsupported sensor and outcome details

records.title: Spinal cord injury therapy based on evoked compound action potentials

decisions.notes: USPTO Official Gazette claim 1 only: ECAP characteristic informs a second therapy-parameter value for an unspecified SCI-associated symptom. No named functional or pain endpoint, patient cohort, performance, movement sensor or clinical outcome is reported in the checked primary claim. Full dependent claims were not rechecked on this route.

updates.издание: USPTO Official Gazette, grant US 12,642,969 B2
updates.модальность: ECAP sensing and stimulation therapy-parameter selection; no movement or outcome measurement in checked claim 1
updates.метод: Claimed method: deliver a spinal-cord stimulation pulse caudal to injury, sense elicited ECAP, identify an unspecified ECAP characteristic, determine a second therapy-parameter value from it, and deliver second therapy.
updates.ограничения: Claim 1 describes an ECAP-informed therapy-parameter change for an unspecified symptom associated with prior spinal-cord damage. The checked official claim does not identify the ECAP characteristic, external sensors, named functions, an empirical cohort, a measured outcome, analgesia, or efficacy. Dependent claims and specification details were not independently rechecked on this route; prior secondary-mirror findings remain dated historical context.

evidence.target_label: Unspecified symptom associated with prior spinal-cord damage; claimed therapy target, not an observed outcome.
